purpose.summary: ORCS02 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system, responsible for calculating patient co-payment amounts (負担金計算) for inpatient (入院) billing. It handles complex Japanese national health insurance co-payment rules including elderly patient limits, income-based caps, regional public expense subsidies, and various special insurance combinations.

verdict.notes: The file is part of the open-source JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) project. Japanese text in comments is EUC-JP encoded but was decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. The program is a co-payment calculation subprogram for inpatient claims. The dialect is most likely GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL as ORCA is known to use that compiler on Linux. No COMP-3 is present despite financial calculations, which may reflect a deliberate style choice or compiler default. Source was truncated at 16,000 chars; the full file is ~1 MB.
